newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's MKC, Stat Corp, say to merge on April 1.
newsitem.headline: Japan's MKC, Stat Corp, say to merge on April 1.

text.p: Japan's MKC Co Ltd and Stat Corp said on Thursday that they would merge on April 1, 1997.
The companies said the merger would strengthen their base in computer-related services, such as building in-house computer networks.
The partners said the new firm would be capitalised at 4.6 billion yen. MKC shareholders will receive 1.72 Stat shares for every MKC share.

They said they expected the new firm to achieve sales of 16.1 billion yen and a parent current profit of 869 million yen in the 1997/98 business year. The annual dividend will be set at six yen per share.
They forecast sales in the following fiscal year of 17.2 billion yen and parent current profit of 1.21 billion yen.
MKC shares closed up 40 yen at 600 yen on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's second section on Thursday.
Stat shares were at 900 yen as of 0755 GMT on the over-the-exchange market.
